  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(flexdashboard)
library(p8105.datasets)
  data("instacart")
```

```{r}
instacart_df = 
  instacart |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  group_by(
    product_id, product_name, department
  ) |> 
  summarize(
    n_purchases = n(),
    mean_cart_position = mean(add_to_cart_order),
    reorder_rate = mean(reordered)
  ) |> 
  ungroup()
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scatterplot: 

```{r}
instacart_df |> 
  filter(department %in% c("dairy eggs", "produce", "canned goods", "beverages", "deli", "snacks", "pantry", "frozen", "meat seafood", "household", "bakery", "personal care", "dry goods pasta", "babies", "other", "breakfast", "international", "alcohol", "bulk", "pets")) |> 
  filter(n_purchases >=19) |> 
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Product: ", product_name, "\nPurchases: ", n_purchases)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~mean_cart_position,
    y = ~reorder_rate,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    color = ~department,
    colors = "viridis",
    text = ~text_label,
    alpha = 0.5
  )
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Boxplot

```{r}
instacart |> 
  group_by(order_id, order_dow) |> 
  summarize(n_products = n()) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  mutate(order_dow = as.factor(order_dow)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_dow,
    y = ~n_products,
    color = ~order_dow,
    type = "box",
    colors = "viridis"
  )
```

### Bar Chart

```{r, warning = FALSE}
instacart |> 
  count(order_hour_of_day) |>
  arrange(order_hour_of_day) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~order_hour_of_day,
    y = ~n,
    color = ~n,
    type = "bar",
    colors = "viridis"
  )
```
